description: This file defines the 'OrderStatusHistory' entity class, representing historical status changes for orders, including fields for status, date added, notification status, and comments. It uses JPA/Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: OrderStatusHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the history of status changes for an order, including metadata and relationships.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this history record.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an order with this history record.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status at this history point.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status for this history record.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the date when this status change was recorded, cloning the date object to prevent external modifications.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date for the status change, cloning the Date object.

methods.name: getCustomerNotified
methods.description: Returns the notification status to the customer.

methods.name: setCustomerNotified
methods.description: Sets the notification status for the customer.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments associated with this status change.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to this status change.
